interface.title: foldmap — Protein topology diagrams from structures
interface.stage_of_work: Analysing and presenting a solved or predicted 3D structure (figure preparation for a paper or talk)
interface.what_it_is_for: Turns a protein structure file into an editable 2D topology map of its helices, strands, loops, ligands, membrane and chain contacts that can be styled, rearranged and exported as figure and data files.

data.note: Used the file-drop uploader with 1UBQ.cif (ubiquitin), 2HHB.cif (haemoglobin tetramer), 1BL8.cif (KcsA channel) and 1TIM.cif (triosephosphate isomerase). The copy of 1LMB.cif (lambda repressor–DNA) staged in this run's data folder was 0 bytes. This was a staging fault: the repository's tests/data/1LMB.cif is a full structure. The app correctly reported '1LMB: no structure in this file' for the empty copy (screens/004.webp). I avoided the ID box and the example pills because the server is offline. The theme chosen for 1UBQ (hydropathy) stayed in effect for later structures.

tree.specific: Turn a PDB/mmCIF structure into a foldmap topology figure of helices, strands, loops, ligands, membrane and chain contacts, tune it, and export SVG/JSON/layout

features.name: Linked schematic / 3D / contact-map highlighting
features.general: Click a part in a 2D schematic and the same residues stay lit in a linked 3D model, shown beside a residue contact map
features.specific: 3D view: the TOPOLOGY panel (+/−/fit zoom), the 3D MODEL (reset view) and a residue contact map are linked; clicking strand A dims everything else and shows it in blue in 3D, and the selection survives 'reset view'
steps: Click an element to keep it lit
Zoom the schematic with the wheel or +/−/fit
serves_tasks: Find where a diagram element sits in the 3D model

features.name: Theme gallery with live preview thumbnails
features.general: Pick a whole visual style from a grid of previews drawn on a reference example, then apply it to your own data
features.specific: 'Browse themes' opens a Themes dialog showing 15 themes drawn on ubiquitin (publication, journal, minimal, print, shaded, trace, rainbow, richardson, cartoon, presentation, flexibility, hydropathy, alphafold, goodsell, blueprint; conservation needs an alignment); clicking one sets Theme, Colour by and the legend
steps: Wait for the thumbnails to render
The figure redraws with that colour scheme and legend
Optionally Reset to theme after tweaks
serves_tasks: Pick an overall visual style and colour scheme

features.name: Per-element edit tabs with table / text toggle
features.general: Edit individual items in a diagram (swap positions, move, rename, recolour, outline, resize, group) through small tables, each of which can be switched to a compact text syntax
features.specific: Edit layout tabs Swap / Move / Rename / Mark / Colour / Width / Domains; each has an Element→value table or an 'as text' box (e.g. 'β2,β3', 'α1=Ub-helix', 'β1=#d1495b,loop:β2=teal', 'β5=#2ca02c, η2'), shows 'Writes: …', and the figure redraws live
steps: Open Edit layout and pick a tab
Turn on 'as text' or fill the table
Type an element name and its new value
Press Enter and watch the figure redraw
serves_tasks: Rename, reorder, recolour and highlight individual elements

features.name: Interaction overlay with chain scope

features.specific: Show > Interactions: H-bonds, Salt bridges, π-stacking, Cation-π, Hydrophobic contacts; 'Interactions between' auto/interchain/chain pairs; H-bond colour; Most H-bonds drawn; the legend reports how many are hidden, e.g. 'H-bonds (7, 24 not shown)'
steps: Read the counts in the legend
serves_tasks: Restrict the drawing to some subunits and show contacts between them

features.name: Chain subset and assembly selection

Read the updated header and figure
serves_tasks: Restrict the drawing to some subunits and show contacts between them

features.name: Membrane band with orientation flip
features.general: Draw a boundary layer behind the diagram so the parts that cross it stand out, and flip which side faces up
features.specific: Show > Membrane off/auto/flip: 'auto' draws a lipid bilayer band behind the KcsA TM helices, with the pore helix at the leaflet; 'flip' inverts the orientation
steps: Check which helices span the band
Press flip if the inside and outside are reversed
serves_tasks: Show which parts cross the membrane

features.name: Textbook-convention vs projected layout toggle
features.general: Switch the same data between a textbook layout convention for a known fold and a geometry-faithful projection
features.specific: Edit layout > Parallel α/β sheets: 'βα row' draws the TIM-barrel row with the first strand repeated (faded) to show barrel closure; 'as projected' gives the 3D-faithful layout with the sheets side by side
steps: Load a structure with a known fold (e.g. a TIM barrel)
Choose 'βα row' for the textbook row
Choose 'as projected' for the 3D-faithful layout and compare

features.name: Sequence track with secondary-structure annotation
